# Freewell Gear

> > Premium camera filters and accessories for drones, smartphones, and professional cameras featuring the M2 Magnetic Quick Swap System.

Freewell Gear specializes in high-performance ND, CPL, VND, and mist filters for DJI drones, iPhone mobile filmmaking, and professional camera systems. The company's innovative M2 Magnetic Quick Swap System enables instant filter changes, while their product line includes anamorphic lenses, thumb grips, travel tripods, and accessories designed for cinematic content creation.

## Key Topics

- M2 Magnetic Quick Swap System
- ND filters (Neutral Density)
- CPL filters (Circular Polarizer)
- VND filters (Variable ND)
- ND/PL hybrid filters
- Snow Mist & Black Mist filters
- DJI drone filters
- iPhone mobile filmmaking
- Anamorphic lenses
- UV filters for lens protection
- Gimbal Safe Technology
- Cinematic video accessories
- Aerial photography filters
- Magnetic filter systems
- Camera lens accessories
